title: git in WSL2 on a /mnt/<drive> repo shows every file modified (mode 100644 -> 100755) and commits new files as executable
symptom: 'git status' lists every tracked file as modified, but 'git diff --stat' shows '0 insertions(+), 0 deletions(-)' and 'git diff --summary' shows 'mode change 100644 => 100755'. New files are committed as 100755. A merge can abort with 'error: Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge' although nothing was edited.
cause: DrvFs mounts Windows drives without Unix permission metadata by default, so every file reports 0777-style permissions and git, with core.fileMode=true, records the executable bit.
fix: Run 'git config core.fileMode false' in the repository (local config), so git ignores mode bits. Repair already-committed modes with: git ls-tree -r HEAD | awk '$1=="100755"{print $4}' | xargs git update-index --chmod=-x && git commit (exclude real scripts; awk's RS='\0' is unsupported in mawk, so use newline-separated paths). Alternatively mount drives with metadata (/etc/wsl.conf: [automount] options = "metadata") or keep the clone in the WSL filesystem.
